main.description: Approves a pending application, admitting the subject as a member.

community.description: The community to admit the subject to.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the approval.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: ApplicationNotFound
errors.description: No pending application exists for the subject in this community.

errors.name: AlreadyMember
errors.description: The subject already holds a member record in this community.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
